# ER Diagram — `erp_token` Schema

> 來源：docs/SCHEMA.md §3.1 `erp_token.api_tokens` + §3.2 `erp_token.token_audit_logs`
> 用途：與 Class Diagram 區分 — ER Diagram 描述 DB 表格、欄位、外鍵；Class Diagram 描述物件模型、方法、繼承

```mermaid
erDiagram
    "erp_token.api_tokens" {
        uuid id PK "gen_random_uuid()"
        varchar_128 created_by_user_id "NOT NULL — ERP user_id (PII)"
        varchar_16  token_prefix "NOT NULL — tk_ + first 8 chars"
        varchar_64  token_hash UK "NOT NULL — SHA-256 hex (64 chars)"
        varchar_100 description "NOT NULL — 1..100 chars"
        varchar_16  status "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (active|revoked)"
        timestamptz created_at "NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"
        timestamptz last_used_at "NULL — auth middleware throttled 1s"
        timestamptz revoked_at "NULL — set on revocation"
        varchar_128 revoked_by_user_id "NULL — set on revocation"
        timestamptz expires_at "NULL — reserved (MVP not enforced)"
        timestamptz hard_delete_eligible_at "NULL — revoked_at + 90 days (GDPR)"
        timestamptz updated_at "NOT NULL trigger maintained"
    }

    "erp_token.token_audit_logs" {
        uuid id PK "gen_random_uuid()"
        varchar_32  action "NOT NULL CHECK (create|revoke|describe_update|admin_list_user_tokens)"
        uuid        target_token_id "NOT NULL — ID-only (HC-1, no DB FK)"
        varchar_16  target_token_prefix "NOT NULL — denormalized (survives hard delete)"
        varchar_128 target_user_id "NOT NULL — token owner (≠ actor when admin)"
        varchar_128 actor_user_id "NOT NULL — operator (PII)"
        varchar_128 actor_username "NOT NULL — display name (PII)"
        varchar_45  ip_address "NULL — IPv4+IPv6 (90d末段遮罩)"
        varchar_500 user_agent "NULL — N8N/Browser UA"
        jsonb       before_state "NULL — required for describe_update / revoke"
        jsonb       after_state "NULL — required for describe_update"
        timestamptz created_at "NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() — append-only"
    }

    "erp_token.api_tokens" ||..o{ "erp_token.token_audit_logs" : "logical reference (HC-1, no DB FK)"
```

## 關聯說明

| 關聯 | 基數 | Source 欄位 | Target | DB FK？ | 應用層保證 |
|------|------|-----------|--------|---------|-----------|
| `erp_token.api_tokens` ↔ `erp_token.token_audit_logs` | 1 : N（0..*） | `token_audit_logs.target_token_id` | `api_tokens.id` | 無（HC-1 ID-only） | UseCase 於同一 DB Transaction 內呼叫 `IAuditLogRepository.AddAsync`；EF Core SaveChangesAsync 一次提交 |

> **記號說明**：`||..o{` 為虛線一對多 — 代表「邏輯引用、無 DB FK」（HC-1 約束）。

## SCHEMA 對應約束

| 約束名稱 | 表 | 欄位 | 說明 |
|---------|-----|------|------|
| `pk_api_tokens` | api_tokens | id | PRIMARY KEY |
| `ux_api_tokens_token_hash` | api_tokens | token_hash | UNIQUE INDEX（驗證熱路徑）|
| `ck_api_tokens_revoked_consistency` | api_tokens | status / revoked_at / revoked_by_user_id | status='revoked' 時三者必須非 NULL |
| `ix_api_tokens_user_id_status` | api_tokens | (created_by_user_id, status) | UI 列表查詢 |
| `ix_api_tokens_hard_delete_eligible` | api_tokens | hard_delete_eligible_at WHERE NOT NULL | GDPR 90d 硬刪批次掃描 |
| `pk_token_audit_logs` | token_audit_logs | id | PRIMARY KEY |
| `ck_audit_logs_action` | token_audit_logs | action | 4 值 enum |
| `ck_audit_logs_state_consistency` | token_audit_logs | action / before_state / after_state | describe_update 必含 before+after；revoke 必含 before |
| `ix_token_audit_logs_target_token` | token_audit_logs | (target_token_id, created_at DESC) | token 審計追溯 |
| `ix_token_audit_logs_actor_created` | token_audit_logs | (actor_user_id, created_at DESC) | 操作者篩選 |
| `ix_token_audit_logs_action_created` | token_audit_logs | (action, created_at DESC) | action 篩選 |
| `ix_token_audit_logs_created_at_brin` | token_audit_logs | created_at (BRIN) | 時間範圍查詢空間優化 |
| `ix_token_audit_logs_after_state_gin` | token_audit_logs | after_state (GIN) | JSONB 全文搜尋 |

> Append-only 約束：DB Role `app_token_writer` 對 `token_audit_logs` 僅有 INSERT + SELECT；UPDATE / DELETE 由 Role 層拒絕（SCHEMA §6.4）。
